summary: Looks up a driver name in the season's Qualifying section and returns the qualifying time/score value. Finds the season races section, searches it for the "Qualifying" string key, then linearly scans up to 104 list entries comparing the driver name via sub_588410. On a match it reads the data entry and returns sub_58850F's value, rejecting results below 10.0; any failure path returns -1.0.

operations.description: Return -1.0 immediately when the driver-name argument a1 is NULL.
SeasonRacesSectionFinder(0) locates the season races data section, stored in v1.
Return -1.0 if v1 is NULL or StringKeyedLinkedListSearch(v1, aQualifying) fails, i.e. no Qualifying section is present.
Infinite scan loop over list indexes v2; NullCheckWrapper(v2) returns each entry v3 (or NULL).
StringPointerAccessor(v3) retrieves the entry name string v5.
When sub_588410(a1, v5) returns zero the driver name matches and the scan breaks.
Loop bound: return -1.0 when the index v2 reaches 104 without a match.
DataEntryAccessor(v4) yields the qualifying data entry, then sub_58850F(v7) reads its value into result.
Return -1.0 when the qualifying value is below 10.0 (invalid/minimum threshold).
Return the qualifying time/score value on success, or -1.0 on every failure path.
